// diagnostic E1102

Jet.ValueNotSendable

A value crossing a task, channel, parallel-worker, or safe-kernel boundary is not sendable.

What

A value crossing a task, channel, parallel-worker, or safe-kernel boundary is not sendable.

Why

Concurrent boundaries move owned data between workers. A view, trait value, mutable capture, borrowed closure, or thread-confined cell cannot cross.

Fix

Send plain owned data, make an ordinary owned copy when permitted, or use `Shared<T>` for deliberate shared state.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.ValueNotSendable: Tests/UI/atomic_task_capture_outlives_its_cell.stderr.

Error: Jet.ValueNotSendable: `flag` cannot be shared into this task: it holds an Atomic cell that does not live long enough
  --> Tests/UI/atomic_task_capture_outlives_its_cell.jet:8:10
    |
  8 |     task raise(flag)
    |          ^^^^^
 Why: The task holds the cell by address, and a task outside a `task.group` can outlive the block that owns the cell
 Fix: Spawn the task in a `task.group` the cell outlives, give the cell to the task with `task &&flag`, or share it with `Shared{…}`
